static_review: Git arguments use argv, not shell interpolation. Export pins a clean non-shallow source ref and checks it before publication.
Import verifies SHA256, exact advertised branch/head/prerequisites, actual tree and uses compare-and-swap for one immutable destination ref.
Local object fetch explicitly disables tag updates, FETCH_HEAD writes and recursive submodule fetching; no checkout, merge, reset, workfile/index write or remote update occurs.
Real isolated tests cover dirty staged/unstaged/untracked preservation, repeated import, fast-forward/divergence/conflict abort and rejection of missing history/identity corruption.
scope: Offline Git transport and explicit integration workflow only; no full-language/product acceptance claim.
